data.name: Super Yooka-Laylee Kart
data.detailed_description:
REVENGE FUELLED RACING

Every setback is another chance to strike back.

As rivals knock you around, your Rage builds. Once unleashed, devastating revenge abilities can flip the race in an instant, turning frustration into brutal payback and near-impossible comeback opportunities for players who never give up the fight.

KARTING EVOLVED

Super Yooka-Laylee Kart is the most complete and advanced karting game yet, full of the genre’s most beloved features, ramping them up and packing all-new punches and surprises that take karting to all-new levels of skill and replayability.

MORE MASTERY THAN EVER BEFORE

The game serves up its unique brand of karting with special moves, all-new advanced techniques and different ways to utilise each weapon. 

Combined with tight controls for pixel-perfect precision, this creates the most high-stakes, high-skill racing for players seeking every possible advantage.

CREATE YOUR OWN RACES, RULES & RIVALRIES

Player-created chaos starts here.

Want homing projectiles only? Insane speed? METEOR SHOWERS?

Create custom race setups, rules and tournaments from a ton of options to serve up your own brand of chaos or competition that will test everyone to their limits… or just have outlandish fun!

REVENGE IS A DISH BEST SERVED IN MANY WAYS

Go online and take on the world, create dedicated lobbies, or dominate the sofa with up to 8-player local split-screen multiplayer built for fierce rivalries, settling scores, and immediate rematches.  

Take on the story campaign to develop your skills and learn new ones across a variety of challenges against crazy CPU racers and rivals... and unlock a secret or two…

NEW WAYS TO WIN: ADAPT YOUR STRATEGIES & RISK IT ALL

Of course, coins make you go faster, but they can also be spent on powerful perks between each race to gain the edge on your rivals.  Should you spend like crazy, maintain a high top speed, or build up a war chest for the final race? Choose your strategies and adapt as you go!

YOO-KART-LAYLEE

Yooka and Laylee, plus fan-favourite friends and foes, come together to settle scores in a vibrant world bursting with arcade energy, personality, and competitive chaos. Ditching platforms for tracks across worlds old and new, Yooka and Laylee are off on a unique karting adventure that will see even the firmest friendships tested to the limit. 

FEATURES

  • Precision-focused arcade racing where skill and mastery matter; multiple high-skill manoeuvres, weapons and advanced racing techniques to master

  • Unique Rage system that rewards tactical comebacks and unbelievable  victories

  • Deep Story Campaign packed with multiple tournaments, rival races, and a high variety of skill-based challenges

  • Online races, time trials and leaderboards 

  • Built from the ground up for networking, we're bringing rollback netcode to the kart racer genre, race against your friends in ultra-responsive, high-octane online racing action with virtually no input lag

  • Dedicated online friend lobbies and up to 8-player local split-screen

  • Extensive race customisation for player-created contests to enjoy with others

  • Beautiful pixel art bursting with Playtonic personality and combined with modern rendering techniques for a fresh, modern vibe

data.short_description: The most skilful, expressive and explosive racer built around mastery, rivalry, and revenge-fuelled comebacks. Race through a solo campaign, compete against rivals online, or create your own custom race setups and challenge your friends.

English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
